svg.text: Review only · Priority 1 · post-rescale grid · no production source, template, export, schema, or Unity mutation
OWNER GATE · CHOOSE / CORRECT ONE DIRECTION
Cream catalog housings organize each noun around one obvious paper or canister
Broad molded lid · green plinth · teal service band · shallow charcoal wells.
Closest to the existing Workhorse office family and easiest to expand cleanly.
The biggest machines can collapse into copier, credenza, or storage-cabinet reads.
Period office machinery: enclosing cream shoulders around dark mechanical cores
Asymmetric shell · deep mechanism bay · stepped base · one unmistakable
Best noun separation at far zoom; Keypunch and Tabulator read as a coordinated production
Dark cores must stay mechanical and period-office, never become sci-fi screens or glowing
Tall repeated bays make each machine feel inspected, serviceable, and issued from
Vertical registers · repeated access doors · cream caps · green structural
Strong catalog provenance and a clean bridge to Sorting Frame and Delivery Uplink.
Rows can read as lockers, server racks, or generic storage instead of working machinery.
Carry B forward: it makes the keypunch bank and tabulator loud without borrowing science-fiction display language.
Use A as the quiet furniture control and C only where a wall/rack noun genuinely earns the vertical register.
No wear · no clutter · no baked UI · no amber/rose · no camera cues
